problem_statement: Windows Terminal and conhost search supports literal text matching, but it does not support regular expression matching. Add regex search support while preserving the existing literal, case-sensitive, and case-insensitive search behavior.
problem_statement_variant: Implement regex search support in the terminal search flow. Regex matching should only be used when the regex search option is selected.
hints: Focus on the search flag flow through TerminalControl and conhost search. The relevant implementation paths include src/cascadia/TerminalControl, src/host, src/interactivity/win32, src/renderer, and src/types.
